decision.explanation: The provided evidence (pmid-25493630) evaluates the efficacy of Tazemetostat (EPZ-6438) in germinal center non-Hodgkin lymphoma (NHL) models, specifically utilizing the WSU-DLCL2 cell line which harbors the EZH2 Y646F mutation. The source material does not contain any data regarding the EZH2 Y407I variant, nor does it address pancreas lymphoma as a disease indication. Consequently, there is no evidence in the provided corpus to support or refute the predictive sensitivity of Tazemetostat for EZH2 Y407I in pancreas lymphoma.
